_about: Per-state search for itemised RHT award/recipient lists published by the state itself. status: parsed | list_found_to_parse | partial (scattered announcements, no consolidated list found yet) | none_found (searched, no list) | blocked. 'searched' = queries/pages actually checked, 2026-11-22. Order of work: Vermont, California, then the rest.

Vermont.note: State's own executed-agreement list (242 agreements) — full Year 1 review page

Texas.note: 68 hospital districts (HHSC xlsx names) x $750,000 (Fox 26 report; = governor $51M); other Texas rounds not itemized

New York.note: DOH awardees.htm (via healthweb-back mirror): 107 rows/55 leads, sum $76.19M ties to governor; release says 90 awards/56 orgs

Colorado.note: hcpf.colorado.gov returns 403 to curl AND to the web-fetch tool (2026-11-22); state says 91 grantees/~250 projects/$169.6M with a list on its site — needs a browser download by the author or another route

Washington.note: HCA Nov 5 PDF: estimated $ per activity; 28 hospitals named for $9.67M with no per-hospital amounts

Minnesota.note: 9 MDH awardee sheets (09/17/2026): all 11 amounts, $12.45M; hospital/FQHC money not itemized

Indiana.note: 8 GROW regional press releases (Sept 3 2026): one award per region ($9.7M-$20.7M), no per-recipient amounts; archived in_regions/

Iowa.note: HHS Notices of Intent to Award (11 PDFs, Jan-Jun 2026) name winners by RFP with no amounts; Year 2 slides give planned totals only

Virginia.note: Aug 28 release names 11 pass-through partners (VHHA Foundation etc.) without amounts; VHCF 25 regional grants reported by Cardinal News — not state-published amounts yet

Ohio.note: 3 governor releases: 22 hospitals + 7 CIN + 6 maternal + OU + pharmacy (38 rows); CIN/maternal amounts exceed headline buckets (FY26+FY27 per release footnote)

Louisiana.note: LDH Oct 8 release read in full: Rural HERO up to $20M (four public systems), Rural Clinician Credit Bank up to $12.7M (53 providers, unnamed), Grow Your Own up to $5M (LCTCS) — ceilings, no per-award amounts or names

Wisconsin.note: DHS program pages: 6 award tables (138 rows); dental table ties to page text

Kentucky.note: CHFS RFAs and CMS notice only; no awardee list found on chfs.ky.gov/ruralhealthplan.ky.gov (searched 2026-11-22)

Montana.note: DPHHS Oct 16 release names 17 EMS agencies ($3.63M total), no per-agency amounts; Sept EMS equipment grants ~$8.7M not itemized

Nebraska.note: public notices of award per initiative

Arizona.note: AHCCCS RHTP pages list solicitations (telehealth $17M, innovative care pilot $21M, TA $2.8M, ADHS navigator) but no awardee list as of 2026-11-23 (searched)

Georgia.note: Phases 1-4 name recipients and give initiative-level $ totals only; no per-award amounts in the DCH releases (checked ga_p2/p3/p4)

Oklahoma.note: program lists via xfdisplay.json -> <path>.content.html fragments (153 rows; programs with no recipients yet omitted)

Wyoming.note: approval sheet read in full: amounts are scattered through notes columns and several names are clipped or EIN-only — a reliable parse was not possible; not published rather than risk wrong amounts

Illinois.note: GATA CSFA program listings have 'Active Awards' tables per RHTP sub-program — earlier 'none' verdict was wrong

North Carolina.note: June 8 release names 39 EMS agencies ($10M total) with no per-agency amounts; RHTP dashboard interactive

West Virginia.note: announced awards by initiative with amounts and counties (per search) — earlier 'none' verdict was wrong

Kansas.note: kdhe.ks.gov 403 to curl; award PDFs exist (REH-CAP/RPGP, CHW+AFIM, Emerging Tech); partial lists appear in hospital-hosted copies of KDHE releases (e.g. haysmed.com RPGP PDF) — not yet parsed

Arkansas.note: 50 awards $149.3M (Aug 27) + $54.6M round 2 (Sep 24); full list at arkansasrhtp.com

Tennessee.note: spreadsheet of 138 grantee projects ($422M over 5 years) on TDH RHTP site

Rhode Island.note: budget amendment by program only; no subrecipient list found (searched 2026-11-22); eohhs.ri.gov 403 to curl

Connecticut.note: $50M grant agreements incl. $46M to four hospitals

Massachusetts.note: no subrecipient list found; RFA for hospitals in Oct 2026

Maine.note: 11 rural hospitals invited to the $30M Rural Hospital Efficiency Fund (names, no amounts); EMR fund awardees not published (searched 2026-11-22)

New Hampshire.note: gonorth.nh.gov and media.sos.nh.gov (Governor & Council agendas/contracts) return 403 to automated downloads (2026-11-23); search summaries cite hub contracts (FHC $66,547,394; CCSNH $6,730,219; USNH $15.6M yr 1) — not verified from a document I could open

New Mexico.note: hca.nm.gov Sept 18 release page 404; Wayback snapshot of /rht/ (Sept 9) predates the regional-lead announcement and lists no recipients

Idaho.note: DHW awardee xlsx as of Oct 16 (114 rows)

Nevada.note: nvha.nv.gov RHT Funded Projects BP1: 7 tables (subrecipient, project, county) with no amounts

North Dakota.note: state says recipients not yet public (Valley News Live Nov 17 2026)

South Dakota.note: doh.sd.gov press-release list links to news.sd.gov releases (JavaScript pages, 1.4 KB to curl); search summaries say recipients not named; contracts to appear on OpenSD

Hawaii.note: rhtp.hawaii.gov / DOH pages: no recipient list found (searched 2026-11-22); CMS Sept 1 release names UH JABSOM $45M, DOH ambulances $13M

Delaware.note: Governor/DHSS Sept 24 release: 3 FQHCs $22.69M; other awards not itemized
